# Push events

The server pushes structured events as `notifications/claude/channel`, so a
coaching surface learns that a rep finished without asking. This table is
generated from [docs/push-events.md](https://github.com/HJewkes/voltras-mcp/blob/main/docs/push-events.md), which carries the
payload shapes and the enabling flags.

It covers the events a coaching flow is built around and is **not guaranteed
exhaustive** — the authoritative list is the set of publish sites under
`src/state/`.

| Event                            | Fires when                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | Auto-stops the set?       |
| -------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------- |
| `rep_finalized`                  | A rep boundary closes the prior rep. See [the timing quirk](https://github.com/HJewkes/voltras-mcp/blob/main/docs/push-events.md#the-rep_finalized-timing-quirk).                                                                                                   | —                         |
| `set_started`                    | `set.start` succeeds, or the server auto-arms on the lifter's own reps (`auto_armed: true`).                                                                                                                                                                        | —                         |
| `set_updated`                    | `set.start` upgraded an auto-armed set in place (`upgraded: true`). See [auto-armed sets](https://github.com/HJewkes/voltras-mcp/blob/main/docs/push-events.md#auto-armed-sets).                                                                                    | —                         |
| `set_ended`                      | `set.end` succeeds. Carries the full rep array and VBT summary — no follow-up `set.get` needed.                                                                                                                                                                     | —                         |
| `set_ended_by_device`            | The user pressed Stop on the Voltra itself while a set was open.                                                                                                                                                                                                    | implicit (device stopped) |
| `connection_changed`             | Any connection-state transition. Disconnects include active-set context.                                                                                                                                                                                            | —                         |
| `timer_complete`                 | A `timer.start` duration elapses.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | —                         |
| `set_target_reached`             | A `rep_count_reached` trigger matches.                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | optional, via `stopOn`    |
| `velocity_loss_exceeded`         | A `velocity_loss_exceeded` trigger matches. See [the baseline](https://github.com/HJewkes/voltras-mcp/blob/main/docs/push-events.md#which-reps-set-the-velocity-baseline).                                                                                          | optional, via `stopOn`    |
| `velocity_loss_watch_suppressed` | At set start, a registered `velocity_loss_exceeded` trigger will never fire because the set's movement class makes the signal invalid. See [the movement-class gate](https://github.com/HJewkes/voltras-mcp/blob/main/docs/push-events.md#the-movement-class-gate). | —                         |
| `idle_timeout`                   | The `idle_timeout_ms` watchdog fires — no rep activity for the configured window.                                                                                                                                                                                   | optional, via `stopOn`    |
| `rest_status`                    | Passive rest-period ticks, only when `VMCP_REST_TIMER=on` auto-arms the cycle at a natural set close.                                                                                                                                                               | —                         |
| `idle_rep_reclaimed`             | An auto-armed set adopted reps a previous idle report already counted. See [auto-armed sets](https://github.com/HJewkes/voltras-mcp/blob/main/docs/push-events.md#auto-armed-sets).                                                                                 | —                         |
| `voice_command_applied`          | The voice fast-path already changed the weight locally. See [the voice fast-path](https://github.com/HJewkes/voltras-mcp/blob/main/docs/push-events.md#the-voice-fast-path).                                                                                        | —                         |
| `voice_command_rejected`         | A spoken weight command was recognized but not applied; rides alongside a `voice_input`.                                                                                                                                                                            | —                         |
| `isometric_phase`                | An isometric hold moves between phases. See [isometric hold phases](https://github.com/HJewkes/voltras-mcp/blob/main/docs/push-events.md#isometric-hold-phases).                                                                                                    | —                         |
| `lease_lost`                     | A multi-step device write stopped partway because another client took the lease. See [below](https://github.com/HJewkes/voltras-mcp/blob/main/docs/push-events.md#lease_lost).                                                                                      | —                         |
